name: 8hats
description: 8Hats public plugin marketplace — agent identity and continuity tooling. Every plugin here is host-portable: the capability is a remote MCP server, so hosts that are not Claude Code can consume the same thing by pointing at the endpoint directly.

plugins.name: bios-implant
plugins.description: BIOS implant — OAuth-authenticated remote MCP access that loads an agent's BIOS (and, over the same implant facade, keeps its worldmodel current).
